verdicts.description: A payload judged through the validator of its message, and what the validator gives (spec 18.2 to 18.5, 18.8).

details.description: What a PAYLOAD_INVALID detail's writer writes of what a validator gave, or its reader reads of a detail (spec 18.6, 18.7).

verdict.description: A payload, its message, the bound and failFast its validator is given, and the violations it gives, the count of the rest and whether it stopped.

message.description: The full name of a message of spec/validations.proto.

runs.description: The payload as bytes repeated, end to end: each run's bytes, that many times.

maximumBytes.description: The bound the validator is given, the detail's it would write (spec 18.6); 2147483647 where none is given.

failFast.description: Whether the validator stops at its first violation (spec 18.5); false where none is given.

more.description: The violations judged past the bound, which the validator counts and holds no more of; 0 where none is given.

stopped.description: That the validator stopped at its first violation; false where none is given.

violation.description: A violation, spec 18.3: its rule's id, its words, and its path, its bounds and forKey where it has them.

bounds.description: The members its rule takes, by their names in validate.proto, as protobuf's JSON mapping writes them.

ruleId.description: Its rule's id; "" for a CEL rule that gives none.

written.description: A violation a validator gave, as a writer is given it: 18.3's members, each possibly empty, which the writer writes none of (spec 18.6).

detail.description: A detail written, write and the detail it gives; or a detail read, the detail and what read gives.

write.description: What a validator gave, and the bound its detail is written under.

detail.description: The detail's text, its lines joined by a line feed.

read.description: What a reader reads of the detail: its violations, more where a closing line counts, stopped where one says so.
